arguments.sql:
WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number AS month, t.calendar_year AS year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS sales
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
year_pairs AS (
    SELECT prod_id, month,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN sales END) AS sales_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN sales END) AS sales_2020,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN sales END) AS sales_2021
    FROM product_month_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, month
),
history AS (
    SELECT month,
           COUNT(sales_2019) AS products_2019,
           COUNT(sales_2020) AS products_2020,
           COUNT(sales_2021) AS products_2021,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN sales_2019 = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_2019,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN sales_2019 <> 0 AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS paired,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN sales_2019 <> 0 AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2021 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS paired_with_2021
    FROM year_pairs
    GROUP BY month
),
rates AS (
    SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS rate_rows, COUNT(to_us) AS nonnull_rates,
           MIN(to_us) AS min_rate, MAX(to_us) AS max_rate
    FROM main.currency
    WHERE country = 'France' AND year = 2021
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT h.*, r.rate_rows, r.nonnull_rates, r.min_rate, r.max_rate
FROM history AS h
LEFT JOIN rates AS r ON r.month = h.month
ORDER BY h.month

arguments.sql:
WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.prod_id,
        co.country_name,
        t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
        t.calendar_month_number AS month,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS monthly_sales
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, co.country_name, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
product_month_history AS (
    SELECT
        prod_id,
        country_name,
        month,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) AS sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) AS sales_2020
    FROM product_month_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, country_name, month
    HAVING MAX(sales_year) = 2021
),
projections AS (
    SELECT
        country_name,
        month,
        sales_2020 + (sales_2020 - sales_2019) / NULLIF(sales_2019, 0) * sales_2020
            AS projected_sales
    FROM product_month_history
)
SELECT
    p.month,
    ROUND(AVG(p.projected_sales * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1)), 2) AS avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM projections AS p
LEFT JOIN main.currency AS c
    ON c.country = p.country_name
   AND c.year = 2021
   AND c.month = p.month
GROUP BY p.month
ORDER BY p.month
